title: Health & Safety Induction Builder
subtitle: Create professional, site-specific, UK HSE-compliant inductions for contractors, staff and visitors.
roleTabsDesc: Steps 2–5 are role-specific — select a role to build and manage that induction:

quickStart.title: New here? Generate a complete draft in one click
quickStart.desc: Creates slides and quiz questions for all three roles at once — takes about 2 minutes. You review, add site photos, and preview before anyone sees it.
quickStart.essentialsTitle: Just the essentials to get started
quickStart.essentialsDesc: Fill these in and the AI will write site-specific, HSE-compliant content straight away. You can add more detail in Step 1 afterwards.
quickStart.generatingDesc: Generating slides and questions for all three roles. This takes about 2 minutes — don't close this tab.
quickStart.draftCreated: Draft created — now review before sending
quickStart.draftCreatedDesc: The AI has written a starting point. Work through the steps below: check the slides, add real site photos, read the quiz questions, then hit Preview before sharing with anyone. Quality comes from your review.

aiModel.title: AI Model
aiModel.desc: Choose which AI model generates the induction slides and quiz questions for all roles.

siteDetails.title: Site Details
siteDetails.desc: Injected into every AI-generated induction — required for genuine CDM 2015 / HSE compliance.
siteDetails.autoSaveNote: Fields auto-save as you type and apply to all role types. After updating, click "Regenerate Induction" in the relevant role tab to include the new details.

inductionContent.title: Induction Content
inductionContent.desc: Choose how inductees receive the safety content — AI-generated slides or your own MP4 video. Fill in the Site Details above before generating.
inductionContent.videoReplaceWarning: Uploading a new video will replace the existing one
inductionContent.dropVideo: Drop video here or click to browse
inductionContent.videoFormats: MP4, MOV, or WebM — max 500 MB
inductionContent.retryHint: Click "Generate Induction" below to try again.
inductionContent.noInductionYet: No induction generated yet. Fill in Site Details (Step 1 above), then click "Generate Induction" to create a UK HSE-compliant induction.
inductionContent.editTextDesc: — edit text or add real site photos to each slide
inductionContent.makeItSpecific: Make it specific to your site
inductionContent.sitePhotoDesc: Add photos of real hazards on your site — a low beam, a loading bay, a chemical store, a slippery floor. Expand any slide below, click Upload Photo, and your real photo replaces the AI-generated image. This makes the induction genuine to your workplace, not generic.
inductionContent.noSlides: No slides yet — generate the induction first.
inductionContent.realSitePhotos: Real site photos replace AI-generated images — makes the induction genuinely specific to your site.

questions.title: Knowledge Questions
questions.desc: AI-generated scenario-based quiz. 80% pass mark required for compliance.
questions.onFailDesc: Controls what information is shown after a failed quiz attempt.

checkpoints.title: Walk-around Checkpoints
checkpoints.desc: QR-code stations around your site — inductees scan each one to confirm they've visited key safety points.
checkpoints.noCheckpoints: No checkpoints yet. Create your first one above.
checkpoints.photoOptional: Photo shows on the scan page (optional)
checkpoints.printNote: Print each checkpoint's QR code and affix it at the corresponding location on site. Inductees scan each one during their walk-around — progress is recorded against their induction record.
checkpoints.photoHint: Each checkpoint can have a photo of the actual location — a fire exit, an assembly point, a first aid station. The photo is shown when the inductee scans the QR code. Upload it from the checkpoint row once created.
checkpoints.infoPlaceholder: e.g. This is the primary assembly point for fire evacuation.

delivery.title: Delivery & Records
delivery.desc: Control how inductees receive this induction and track completion records.
delivery.hazardReportEnabled: Inductees can photo-report hazards they spot during the walk-around
delivery.hazardReportDisabled: Hazard reporting is disabled — inductees can only confirm checkpoint visits
delivery.generateFirst: Generate an induction first to enable kiosk integration
delivery.noInductionWarningDesc: The recipient will see a placeholder. Generate first for the best experience.
delivery.dialogIntro: Select a {{type}} or enter details manually. They'll receive a secure link to complete the induction remotely.
delivery.searchPerson: Search by name, company or email…

sentLinks.title: Sent Induction Links
sentLinks.desc: Recent induction links. Use "Reset Quiz" if someone has used all their attempts.
sentLinks.linksDesc: Links sent to contractors, staff and visitors appear here.
sentLinks.quizResetDesc: The person can now retake the quiz.

toasts.photoUploadedDesc: Custom photo saved — it will appear on this slide when you generate.
toasts.questionsClearedDesc: All questions removed — regenerate to get fresh ones.
toasts.missingDetailsDesc: Please enter a name and email address
toasts.videoUploadedDesc: Your custom induction video has been saved.
toasts.videoRemovedDesc: The custom video has been removed.
toasts.invalidFileTypeDesc: Please select an MP4, MOV, or WebM video file.
toasts.couldNotOpenPreview: Could not open preview — please try again

compliance.title: About UK HSE Compliance
compliance.desc: Inductions are AI-generated using your site details and industry context, designed to meet UK Health & Safety Executive (HSE) requirements.
compliance.assessmentNote: Knowledge assessment: scenario-based questions, 80% pass mark required. All completions are logged for your audit trail.
